title.html: Every detail belongs to the experience.

body.html: For a made-to-measure interior, discussion begins with available surfaces and fitted furniture. Where will a tray sit, what must it hold and how will it be stored? Material, securing and special operating requirements must be specified and reviewed for the actual project. They are not inherent properties of a leather accessory.

title.html: Make precise use of the available space

body.html: On board, every available centimetre matters. We develop trays, desk pads, tissue box covers and small organisers entirely around your dimensions and intended contents. One-offs and very small runs are welcome and are handmade in the EU. Materials are selected for the particular setting and your project team’s requirements.

title.html: Include the operating conditions in the brief

body.html: Dry interiors, bathrooms and exterior areas present different requirements. Moisture, cleaning products, secure stowage and any project-specific requirements need to be discussed before materials are selected. A bespoke design does not in itself imply marine certification or suitability for a particular technical specification.
Desk pads and notepad holders for suites, workspaces and meeting tables. Developed as a coordinated collection of formats, materials and branding.
